reported.title: Debounce timer reset on every raw change prevents settling
reported.description: trigEdge is reset whenever raw differs from lastTrig, so a bouncing contact keeps restarting the 25 ms window; the stable state only updates after 25 ms of no raw changes, which is correct in intent but the edge tracking uses lastTrig rather than the stable value, so a brief glitch that returns to the stable level still resets the timer and can delay or miss a valid 30 ms press.

reported.title: Pulse start latency can exceed 120 ms
reported.description: The press is only accepted after DEBOUNCE_MS of stability plus loop latency, and because trigEdge is set on the first raw change, a 30 ms press that bounces can push detection past the 120 ms requirement; the debounce should latch on the stable LOW and start the pulse immediately when stable.

reported.title: millis rollover breaks debounce and heartbeat comparisons
reported.description: All timing uses unsigned subtraction which is rollover-safe, so this is not a bug; however trigEdge is initialized to 0 and if a press occurs before 25 ms after boot the subtraction is fine. No rollover bug present.

judge_input.spec:
- Trigger on D2 with INPUT_PULLUP (active LOW); glue solenoid on D8; armed LED on D11.
- A settled press as short as 30 ms starts a 2500 ms HIGH pulse on D8 within 120 ms.
- Retriggers during an active pulse are ignored.
- Debounce the trigger with 25 ms of stability.
- Keep D11 HIGH when idle and LOW while the solenoid pulse is active.
- Print `glue dots=<n> busy=<0|1>` every 500 ms.
